marca.assinatura: Handmade burgers with a taste of the divine

inicio.heroTexto: Two places: one in Porto, one by the sea in Leça da Palmeira. The same roll call of saints at both.

bestSellers.texto: The ones the kitchen makes over and over. They carry the stamp on the menu.

casas.texto: Two addresses, one menu. Take whichever is closer.

cozinha.titulo: Made by hand, in front of whoever's eating

notas.acompanhamento: Every burger comes with sliced or straight-cut potatoes. Sweet potato fries are also available, under extras.
notas.infantil: Includes sliced or straight-cut potatoes and a drink of your choice (mini Coca-Cola, mini orange Fanta, Bongo or 0.25 L water). For children up to 12 only.
notas.iva: VAT included at the applicable rate.
notas.alergenios: Allergen information is available at the restaurant — just ask.
notas.precos: Prices from the 2024 menu, pending confirmation.

inicio.titulo: Santo Burga — handmade burgers in Porto and Leça
inicio.descricao: Handmade burgers with a taste of the divine. Two places: Porto and Leça da Palmeira. Home of the famous square burger.

ementa.descricao: The full Santo Burga menu: beef and chicken saints, dry-aged beef, vegetarian options, desserts and drinks.
